body.name: Coherent nuisance-rate handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathfrak F\): on \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit a single tensor-product B-spline product likelihood for \((\pi,M_A,M_Z,f)\) with \(s_n\asymp n^{(d_X+1)/(2\beta+d_X+1)}\), choose from the \(K!\) common permutations the maximizer of the empirical training-sample minimum diagonal-minus-largest-off-diagonal self-report probability, and derive \(w,W,B,d,D,R,N,h,G,b_{(\cdot)},b_U\) by the corrected plug-in Bayes and \(D\)-orthogonal projection identities
